## Project: NCLEX-PN Trainer

A study tool for nursing licensure exam prep — your personal cheap/free alternative to paid qbanks. Stores everything in plain JSON files so you can edit it on your phone in a text editor if needed.

## Rules That Apply

| Rule | Constraint |
|------|-----------|
| **Storage** (rule) | Plain JSON only — no database. Mobile access + manual editability |
| **Copyright** (rule) | Zero actual question text from UWorld, Archer, Kaplan, etc. (even paraphrased). Topic tags + your notes only |
| **Scope** (rule) | Every plan template must be PN scope — reinforce, monitor, report, follow care plan. No RN independent stuff |
| **Gamification** (rule) | Parked: no streaks, leaderboards, or gamification (distraction risk). Can revisit later |
